prompt: Before checking whether nums[i] is in seen, what must seen contain?

options.text: Exactly the values at indices before i
Exactly the values at indices up to and including i
Every value in nums, including values after i
Only values already known to occur more than once

explanation: Before the membership check at index i, seen contains exactly the values from earlier indices. The membership check happens before insertion: if nums[i] is already in seen, it matches an earlier value; otherwise, add it, preserving the invariant for the next index.
